# Drexorium Labs — Complete Technical & Entity Knowledge Base

## 1. Corporate Identity & Entity Graph
- **Legal Name**: Drexorium Labs Private Limited
- **Canonical Website**: https://drexoriumlabs.vercel.app/
- **Headquarters**: Aerospace Research Corridor, Bengaluru, Karnataka, India
- **Launch Assembly Facility**: Satish Dhawan Space Centre (SDSC-SHAR), Sriharikota, LC-2
- **Founder & CEO**: Raj Patil (URI: `https://rajpatil-port.vercel.app/#person`)
- **Primary Organization URI**: `https://drexoriumlabs.vercel.app/#organization`
- **Sister AI Research Partner**: Zydrakon AI (URI: `https://zydrakon-ai-website.vercel.app/#organization`)

## 2. Propulsion & Launch Systems Architecture
- **Vehicle Classification**: GSLV-MK3 Heavy Orbital Launch Vehicle (GSLV-DRX-LVM3)
- **Stage 0 (Booster)**: Twin S200 Solid Strap-on Boosters (HTPB propellant, 2 x 5,150 kN sea-level thrust)
- **Stage 1 (Core Stage)**: L110 Liquid Core Stage powered by twin Vikas hypergolic engines (UDMH + N2O4, 1,598 kN vacuum thrust)
- **Stage 2 (Upper Stage)**: C25 Cryogenic Upper Stage powered by CE-20 Engine (Liquid Hydrogen LH2 + Liquid Oxygen LOX, 200 kN vacuum thrust, 443s Isp)
- **Payload Capacity**: 4,000 kg to Geostationary Transfer Orbit (GTO), 10,000 kg to Low Earth Orbit (LEO)

## 3. OrbitNet-Bio Artificial Intelligence Framework
- **Architecture**: Deep Neural Transformer trained on multi-spectral satellite telemetry and orbital bio-imagery
- **Developer**: Zydrakon AI in collaboration with Drexorium Labs AI Division
- **Latency Benchmark**: 0.42 ms single-cell classification latency on FPGA edge accelerators
- **Throughput**: 24,469 single-cell image parses per 24 hours
- **Autonomous Features**: Closed-loop orbital trajectory correction, microgravity cell state prediction, multi-constellation ground station failover routing

## 4. Space Biotechnology & Microgravity Research
- **Orbital Hardware**: Microfluidic Lab-on-a-Chip Bio-Cassette Incubators
- **Biological Focus**: *Deinococcus radiodurans* radiation repair mechanisms, monocrystalline protein crystal growth under zero-gravity, synthetic micro-algae O2 generation
- **Environmental Controls**: Temperature stability ±0.05°C, pressurized micro-chambers (101.3 kPa), radiation shielding (lead-bismuth alloy)
- **Cleanroom & Planetary Protection**: ISO-14644 Class 5 Cleanroom, COSPAR Planetary Protection Category IV-B

## 5. AeroMars Autonomous Scout Drone Specifications
- **Computer Vision Engine**: 100 FPS Edge-AI Neural Vision (YOLO-Space architecture)
- **Sensor Suite**: Dual IR thermal sensors, LiDAR terrain elevation mapper, multi-spectral radiation sensor
- **Flight Autonomy**: Real-time obstacle detection, automated surface landing, GPS-denied inertial navigation
